tasks.label: EAS: iPhone development build
tasks.command:
$env:Path = 'C:\Program Files
odejs;' + $env:Path; $env:CI = $null; $env:EAS_NO_VCS = '1'; $env:EAS_PROJECT_ROOT = (Get-Location).Path; & 'C:\Program Files
odejs
px.cmd' --yes eas-cli@25.1.1 build --platform ios --profile development

tasks.label: EAS: iPhone TestFlight beta build
tasks.command:
$env:Path = 'C:\Program Files
odejs;' + $env:Path; $env:CI = $null; $env:EAS_NO_VCS = '1'; $env:EAS_PROJECT_ROOT = (Get-Location).Path; & 'C:\Program Files
odejs
px.cmd' --yes eas-cli@25.1.1 build --platform ios --profile beta

tasks.label: EAS: Submit verified TestFlight beta
tasks.command:
$env:Path = 'C:\Program Files
odejs;' + $env:Path; $env:CI = $null; $env:EAS_NO_VCS = '1'; $env:EAS_PROJECT_ROOT = (Get-Location).Path; & 'C:\Program Files
odejs
px.cmd' --yes eas-cli@25.1.1 submit --platform ios --profile beta --id '${input:testflightBuildId}'

inputs.description: Verified FINISHED iOS beta build UUID (store distribution, not a development build)
